segments.name: Ryan Specialty
segments.description: Acts as a specialty insurance intermediary, placing complex risks for retail brokers and providing underwriting and distribution services for carriers.
segments.evidence: The Company's offerings cover a wide variety of sectors including commercial, industrial, institutional, governmental, and personal through one operating segment, Ryan Specialty.

revenueModel.text: Insurance brokers and carriers pay Ryan Specialty commissions and fees for placing specialty risks and for delegated underwriting services.
revenueModel.evidence: For retail insurance brokers, we assist in the placement of complex or otherwise hard-to-place risks.
